app.title: Help desk
language.label: Language
error.loadFailed: Could not load from the core.
permissionHint.tickets.work: Write internal notes; change state and priority; link assets, services and parent tickets; take a ticket for oneself.
permissionHint.tickets.reply: Send replies by e-mail and keep reply drafts.
permissionHint.tickets.open: Open a ticket that no message started, e.g. after a phone call.
permissionHint.tickets.assign: Make another agent the assignee, or take a ticket away from them.
permissionHint.tickets.move: Move a ticket that was opened for the wrong customer.
permissionHint.inbox.triage: Open a ticket from a message, attach it to a ticket or discard it.
permissionHint.customers.manage: Add, rename and offboard customers; their mail domains, sites and requesters.
permissionHint.catalog.manage: Add, change and retire assets and services; which customers use a service and which assets it runs on.
permissionHint.agents.manage: Add agents, change their role, reset their password, deactivate and reactivate them.
permissionHint.roles.manage: Create, change and remove roles, and choose the default one.
permissionHint.addons.manage: Switch add-ons on and off, and see how delivering events to them goes.
permission.mail.view: View the state of the mail
permissionHint.mail.view: See whether reading and sending mail work, and what waits in the outbox.
tickets.title: Title
newTicket.title: Title
newTicket.requesterHint: A new address is registered as a requester of the customer. Leave it empty for work nobody asked for, such as planned maintenance.
newTicket.notePlaceholder: For example, what the requester said on the phone…
newTicket.noteHint: Kept on the ticket as an internal note: only agents see it, and it is never sent to the requester.
filters.label: Filter tickets
ticket.confirmClose: Close ticket #{number}? Closing is final: the ticket cannot be reopened, and a new message from the requester will open a new ticket.

ticket.unlinked.one: Unlinked {count} asset or service that did not fit the new customer.
ticket.unlinked.other: Unlinked {count} assets and services that did not fit the new customer.

ticket.emptyTimeline: Nothing written on this ticket yet.
ticket.closedNotice: This ticket is closed, which is final. A new message from the requester opens a new ticket. Agents can still add internal notes.
entry.gaveUp: This message was not sent: the help desk stopped trying. Last error: {error}
entry.retrying: Not sent yet, will try again: {error}
composer.hintReplyWroteFrom: Sent by e-mail to {email}, where the requester last wrote from on this ticket.
composer.hintPickAddress: The requester has several addresses and has not written on this ticket: choose the one to write to.
composer.hintClosed: The ticket is closed, so it gets no more replies. Only agents see a note.
composer.hintNote: Only agents see a note. It is never sent to the requester.
composer.hintNoRequester: This ticket has no requester, so there is nobody to reply to. Only agents see a note.
composer.notePlaceholder: Write a note for the agents…
composer.draftNotSaved: The draft could not be saved: {error}
composer.notAllowed: Your role allows reading this ticket, not writing on it.
move.requesterToo: The requester was assigned to the wrong customer: move them too

move.requesterTooWithTickets.one: The requester was assigned to the wrong customer: move them too, with their {count} other ticket
move.requesterTooWithTickets.other: The requester was assigned to the wrong customer: move them too, with their {count} other tickets

move.requesterStays: Keep the requester with {customer} and remove them from this ticket
move.linksWarning: This ticket has linked assets or services. Its assets belong to {customer}, so moving unlinks them; services the new customer does not use are unlinked too.
move.unlinkService: the service {name}, which {customer} does not use
move.keepsLinks: The linked services stay: {customer} uses them.
parent.title: Parent ticket
parent.none: Not attached to a parent ticket.
parent.attachHint: A parent ticket is a ticket of the help desk's own organization that tracks one failure affecting several customers.
parent.noChildren: No child tickets. When a failure affects several customers, attach each customer's ticket to this one from that ticket's page.

parent.resolveHint.one: The {count} open or waiting child ticket is resolved, and its requester gets this message. This ticket stays as it is.
parent.resolveHint.other: The {count} open or waiting child tickets are resolved, and each requester gets this message. This ticket stays as it is.

parent.confirmResolve.one: Resolve {count} child ticket of #{number} and send the message to its requester?
parent.confirmResolve.other: Resolve {count} child tickets of #{number} and send the message to each requester?

customers.title: Customers
customers.name: Name
customers.newDomainsHint: Separate several domains with spaces or commas. Mail from a registered domain opens tickets for the customer.
customer.offboardedNotice: Offboarded on {date}. Its history stays, but it gets no new tickets: every message from its requesters and domains waits in the inbox.
customer.domainsHint: Mail from an unknown sender at one of these domains opens a ticket for this customer and registers the sender as a requester.
customer.offboardHint: An offboarded customer keeps its history but gets no new tickets; its mail waits in the inbox.
customer.confirmOffboard: Offboard {name}? Its history stays, but it gets no new tickets: every message from its requesters and domains, replies included, will wait in the inbox. It cannot be undone here.
sites.title: Sites
sites.hint: Where the customer's requesters and assets are. A retired site stays visible but gets no new requesters or assets.
sites.name: Site name
sites.confirmRetire: Retire {name}? It stays visible, but no requester or asset can be put at it any more.
assets.title: Assets
assets.name: Name
assets.confirmRetire: Retire {name}? It stays on the tickets that refer to it, but no ticket or service can link it any more.
customerServices.title: Services it uses
customerServices.helpDeskUsesAll: The help desk's own organization uses every service.
services.title: Services
services.name: Name
services.addHint: The help desk's own organization uses a new service from the start.
service.retireHint: A retired service stays on the tickets that refer to it, but no ticket, customer or asset can be linked to it any more.
service.confirmRetire: Retire {name}? It stays on the tickets that refer to it, but no ticket, customer or asset can be linked to it any more. It cannot be undone here.
service.retiredNotice: Retired on {date}. It stays on the tickets that refer to it, but gets no new links.
service.runsOnHint: They can belong to any customer.
service.noAssets: No active asset left to link
inbox.readOnly: Your role allows reading the inbox, not sorting it.
inbox.confirmDiscard: Discard the message from {sender}? It will not become part of any ticket.
inbox.notATicket: Type the number of an existing ticket.
proposals.title: Proposals from {addon}
proposals.hint: Suggestions from {addon}: nothing changes until an agent accepts one.
proposals.reply: A draft reply to the requester:
proposals.replaceDraft: Replace what you have written in the composer with the draft from {addon}?
proposals.draftReady: The draft from {addon} is below. Nothing has been sent yet: read it, change it if needed, then send it yourself.
account.title: Your account
account.name: Name

account.passwordHint.one: At least {count} character. Your other sessions end; this one stays.
account.passwordHint.other: At least {count} characters. Your other sessions end; this one stays.

account.tooShort.one: The new password needs at least {count} character.
account.tooShort.other: The new password needs at least {count} characters.

account.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
account.changed: Password changed. Your other sessions have ended.
admin.title: Administration
admin.notAllowed: Your role does not allow this part of the administration.
agents.title: Agents
agents.name: Name
agents.confirmOwnRole: Change your own role? It applies at once: you may lose access to this page.
agents.confirmReset: Reset the password of {name}? They are signed out everywhere and need the new password, shown once, to sign in again.
agents.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? They are signed out and can no longer sign in, and the tickets assigned to them that are not closed lose their assignee. Their history stays.

agents.deactivated.one: {name} is deactivated. {count} ticket lost its assignee.
agents.deactivated.other: {name} is deactivated. {count} tickets lost their assignee.

agents.reactivated: {name} is reactivated and can sign in again.
agents.handOutHint: You can act only on agents whose role allows nothing beyond your own, and give only such roles. Only an Administrator acts on Administrators. You change your own password from your account.
agents.addHint: The core generates the first password; you see it once, to pass on to the new agent.
agents.shownOnce: Copy it now: it is not shown again.
roles.hint: A role is a set of permissions; every agent has one. Reading tickets, the inbox, customers and the catalog needs no permission.
roles.administratorHint: Built in: it allows everything, including what later versions add, and can be neither changed nor removed. At least one active agent always has it.
roles.notYours: This role has permissions your own role does not have, so you cannot change it.
roles.name: Name
roles.defaultNotRemovable: The default role cannot be removed.
roles.inUse: A role some agent has cannot be removed.
addons.title: Add-ons
addons.name: Add-on
addons.register: Add-ons are registered on the server's command line, with hd addon add …, which also makes their token and event secret (see docs/deploy.md).
mail.hint: Mail settings live in the server's configuration and Secrets, not in this screen.
mail.readingOff: Reading mail is not configured: no message reaches the inbox or opens tickets.
mail.sendingOff: Sending is not configured: replies wait in the outbox.
mail.nothingWaiting: No reply is waiting to be sent.

mail.waitingSince.one: {count} reply waits to be sent, since {date}.
mail.waitingSince.other: {count} replies wait to be sent, the oldest since {date}.

mail.subject: Subject
